recipes.summary: Melt-in-your-mouth slow-braised chuck roast with caramelized carrots and rich brown gravy.
directions: Generously season chuck roast on all sides with salt and cracked pepper.
Sear meat in a heavy Dutch oven until a deep mahogany crust forms on both sides.
Add onion, carrots, and beef broth; cover tightly with heavy lid.
Bake in oven for 3 hours until roast falls apart when pressed with a fork.
Skim fat from cooking liquid, thicken with a cornstarch slurry if desired, and spoon over carved roast.

recipes.summary: Crisp Neapolitan-style thin crust topped with San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and sweet basil.
directions: Place pizza stone or heavy baking sheet in oven and preheat to highest temperature (500°F / 260°C).
Stretch pizza dough on parchment paper to a 12-inch circle.
Spread crushed tomatoes in a thin layer, leaving a 1/2-inch border for the crust.
Distribute mozzarella pieces evenly across the sauce.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until crust is blistered and cheese is melted with golden spots.
Top immediately with fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
